note: The enrollment script (laptop) and the Android app (phone) MUST follow this exactly, or stored templates will not match live faces.

detector.phone: ML Kit face detection (landmark mode ALL), or the same YuNet ONNX via ONNX Runtime for exact parity

alignment.method: closed-form least-squares similarity (rotation + uniform scale + translation, no reflection); a = sum(x*u + y*v)/sum(x^2+y^2), b = sum(x*v - y*u)/sum(x^2+y^2) on centred points; bilinear sampling
landmark_order: eye on the IMAGE-left (subject's right eye)
eye on the IMAGE-right (subject's left eye)

embedder.family: MobileFaceNet trained on WebFace600K (InsightFace buffalo_sc pack)
embedder.license: InsightFace pretrained models: non-commercial research use only
embedder.input: float32 tensor [1, 3, 112, 112], NCHW, RGB channel order

template.enrollment: mean of per-photo embeddings, then L2-normalise
template.storage: MEC applies the cancelable transform t[i] = signs[i] * e[permutation[i]] then AES-GCM encrypts

matching.metric: cosine similarity (dot product of L2-normalised, identically transformed vectors)
matching.assignment: one-to-one: each face matches at most one student and each student at most one face (greedy by highest score)
matching.calibrate: Re-tune both numbers on your own class photos; report FAR/FRR in the research write-up.
